criteria.criterion: RFC 0003 extends the governed Knowledge Wiki with stable identities and no parallel public database.
Manifest, asset, derivative, occurrence, and edition IDs resolve consistently.
Private source binding remains opaque, fail-closed, and free of private paths or identifying source fingerprints.
The exact occurrence binds image, crop, copy context, caption, credit, viewport, and action without confusing custody and authorship.
Visible observation, metadata, first-person recollection, interpretation, and collective context remain distinct.
Curatorial evaluation preserves embodiment, dissent, and artistic openness without scoring or automated publication.
Caption and credit assertions resolve to bounded statements, and unknowns are not polished into facts.
Rights, represented-person, artwork, caption, collective-credit, staging, production, and indexing gates remain separate.
Generated placement, rights, impact, usage, and health views are deterministic and current.
The pilot reports one completed canary and twelve migration items without treating incompleteness as shame or false completion.

hard_gates: No private path, People label, coordinate, raw permission correspondence, or private source locator enters public Git.
No occurrence becomes active while photographer rights, represented-person review, production, or indexing remain open.
Named artistic lenses are explicitly simulations, not participation or endorsement.
A derivative checksum mismatch fails the build.
Jamie approves any production publication and indexing change separately.

open_by_design: Jamie approval of an unchanged candidate
